headline.zh: 苏州河畔日式庭院咖啡
headline.en: Japanese courtyard cafe by Suzhou Creek

traits.zh: 距苏州河约300米，可享河景
traits.en: About 300m from Suzhou Creek with river views

traits.zh: 门前有开放式露天庭院
设室外碎石区、石板径与坐凳
traits.en: Outdoor seating with gravel, stone path and benches

traits.zh: 使用埃塞俄比亚、哥伦比亚等精选咖啡豆
traits.en: Uses Ethiopian, Colombian and other select beans

traits.zh: 招牌甜品含雪山栗子蒙布朗、草莓芭菲
traits.en: Signature desserts include Mont Blanc and strawberry parfait

linger.zh: 有庭院与窗景座位适合久坐
linger.en: Courtyard and window seats invite lingering
